description: This file defines an API class for managing US tax exemption details of employees within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes methods for retrieving and updating tax exemption information for specified employees.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee US tax exemption details including retrieval and update operations.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemptionService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmpUsTaxExemptionService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the tax exemption details for a specified employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET operation to retrieve employee tax exemption data.

methods.name: throwIfDisabled
methods.description: Checks configuration to determine if tax exemptions are accessible; throws exception if disabled.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the tax exemption details for a specified employee.

methods.name: saveTaxExemption
methods.description: Creates or updates the EmpUsTaxExemption entity based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the PUT operation to update employee tax exemption data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; raises exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method not implemented; raises exception if called.
